exposure: Use of a linear cutter to create a bloodless hysterotomy
Use of a vessel sealing system (VSS) to dissect the vesicouterine tissue
cohort: 23 patients undergoing cesarean hysterectomy for the treatment of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders
finding: Use of a linear cutter and closure of the lower anastomosis with VSS prior to clamping uterine artery during cesarean hysterectomy can significantly reduce blood loss and transfusion rates.
